name: OpenTweaks
description: Transparent, reversible Windows tweaks. Every entry shows exactly what it runs and how to undo it. No telemetry, no network calls, no paywall.

tweaks.name: Remove startup app delay
tweaks.description: Launch your startup apps right away instead of after Windows' ~10 second wait.

tweaks.name: Favor the app you're using
tweaks.description: Give the window in front more CPU time so it feels more responsive.

tweaks.name: Disable hibernation
tweaks.description: Turn off hibernation and reclaim disk space equal to your RAM (also disables Fast Startup).

tweaks.name: High Performance power plan
tweaks.description: Stop the CPU from down-clocking to save power. Revert goes back to Balanced.

tweaks.name: Ultimate Performance power plan
tweaks.description: Unlock and switch to the hidden Ultimate Performance plan (a notch above High Performance).

tweaks.name: Disable power throttling
tweaks.description: Stop Windows slowing down background apps to save battery. Best on a desktop.

tweaks.name: Disable SysMain (Superfetch)
tweaks.description: Stop the preloading service. Helps on SSDs and low-RAM PCs; leave on for old HDDs.

tweaks.name: Enable Game Mode
tweaks.description: Let Windows hold back background work while you're playing a game.

tweaks.name: Disable Game DVR recording
tweaks.description: Turn off the Game Bar background capture that quietly costs a few FPS.

tweaks.name: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling
tweaks.description: Let the GPU manage its own memory (HAGS). Can cut latency on modern GPUs. Needs a restart.

tweaks.name: Disable mouse acceleration
tweaks.description: Turn off 'enhance pointer precision' for a 1:1, predictable mouse feel.

tweaks.name: Prioritize games over background tasks
tweaks.description: Let games and multimedia use more CPU (SystemResponsiveness = 0). Revert restores the default.

tweaks.name: Raise the games scheduling priority
tweaks.description: Bump the priority Windows gives games (MMCSS Games task). Helps some games, not all.

tweaks.name: Disable advertising ID
tweaks.description: Stop apps using your ad ID to track you across apps.

tweaks.name: Minimize telemetry
tweaks.description: Send Microsoft the least diagnostic data your edition allows.

tweaks.name: Disable tailored experiences
tweaks.description: Stop Windows using your data to personalize tips and ads.

tweaks.name: Disable activity history
tweaks.description: Stop Windows recording and uploading your activity timeline.

tweaks.name: Disable suggestions & tips
tweaks.description: Turn off Start/Settings suggestions, tips and promoted 'recommended' content.

tweaks.name: Don't track most-used apps
tweaks.description: Stop Start listing your most-used and recently added apps.

tweaks.name: Stop the telemetry service
tweaks.description: Disable the Connected User Experiences/Telemetry service (DiagTrack).

tweaks.name: Disable Cortana
tweaks.description: Turn off the Cortana assistant by policy.

tweaks.name: Turn off location access
tweaks.description: Block apps and Windows from using your location.

tweaks.name: Stop feedback requests
tweaks.description: Stop Windows popping up asking for feedback.

tweaks.name: Stop auto-installed promoted apps
tweaks.description: Stop Windows silently installing promoted third-party apps.

tweaks.name: Disable Nagle's algorithm
tweaks.description: Send small packets immediately for lower latency in twitchy games. Needs a restart.
apply: Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces' | ForEach-Object { New-ItemProperty -Path $_.PSPath -Name TcpAckFrequency -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null; New-ItemProperty -Path $_.PSPath -Name TCPNoDelay -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null }
revert: Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces' | ForEach-Object { Remove-ItemProperty -Path $_.PSPath -Name TcpAckFrequency -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-ItemProperty -Path $_.PSPath -Name TCPNoDelay -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

tweaks.name: Disable network throttling
tweaks.description: Remove the multimedia network throttle. Helps on fast connections. Needs a restart.

tweaks.name: Disable TCP auto-tuning
tweaks.description: Can steady your ping on unstable connections - but may slow large downloads. Test it.
apply: netsh int tcp set global autotuninglevel=disabled
revert: netsh int tcp set global autotuninglevel=normal

tweaks.name: Disable RSC (receive coalescing)
tweaks.description: Deliver packets without bundling them, for slightly lower latency.
apply: netsh int tcp set global rsc=disabled
revert: netsh int tcp set global rsc=enabled

tweaks.name: Disable ECN
tweaks.description: Turn off Explicit Congestion Notification for compatibility with some routers.
apply: netsh int tcp set global ecncapability=disabled
revert: netsh int tcp set global ecncapability=enabled

tweaks.name: Disable TCP timestamps
tweaks.description: Drop timestamp bytes from each packet for a touch less overhead.
apply: netsh int tcp set global timestamps=disabled
revert: netsh int tcp set global timestamps=enabled

tweaks.name: Stop auto-tuning overrides
tweaks.description: Stop Windows quietly overriding your auto-tuning choice on its own.
apply: netsh int tcp set heuristics disabled
revert: netsh int tcp set heuristics default

tweaks.name: Free the reserved 20% bandwidth
tweaks.description: Let apps use the 20% of bandwidth Windows reserves for QoS.

tweaks.name: Disable update P2P sharing
tweaks.description: Stop Windows uploading updates to other PCs over your connection.

tweaks.name: Use Cloudflare DNS (1.1.1.1)
tweaks.description: Point your network adapters at fast, private Cloudflare DNS. Revert returns to automatic (DHCP).

tweaks.name: Flush DNS cache
tweaks.description: Clear cached lookups to fix sites that won't resolve. One-time.

tweaks.name: Visual effects: best performance
tweaks.description: Turn off animations and shadows so the desktop feels instant.

tweaks.name: Disable transparency
tweaks.description: Turn off taskbar/window transparency - a small GPU saving.

tweaks.name: Disable window animations
tweaks.description: Turn off the minimize/maximize animations for snappier windows.

tweaks.name: Remove menu delay
tweaks.description: Make menus open instantly instead of after ~400 ms.

tweaks.name: Show file extensions
tweaks.description: Always show file extensions in Explorer - handy and safer.

tweaks.name: Disable dynamic tick
tweaks.description: Keep the system timer steady for lower latency in games/audio. Needs a restart.

tweaks.name: Don't force the HPET clock
tweaks.description: Let Windows pick the best timer instead of being forced onto HPET. Needs a restart.

tweaks.name: Enable MSI mode for GPU
tweaks.description: Switch the GPU to message-signaled interrupts - can reduce stutter. Needs a restart. Test stability.
apply: Get-PnpDevice -Class Display -Status OK -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $p = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Enum\$($_.InstanceId)\Device Parameters\Interrupt Management\MessageSignaledInterruptProperties"; if (Test-Path $p) { New-ItemProperty -Path $p -Name MSISupported -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null } }
revert: Get-PnpDevice -Class Display -Status OK -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $p = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Enum\$($_.InstanceId)\Device Parameters\Interrupt Management\MessageSignaledInterruptProperties"; if (Test-Path $p) { New-ItemProperty -Path $p -Name MSISupported -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null } }

tweaks.name: Disable memory compression
tweaks.description: Stop Windows compressing RAM - frees CPU but uses more memory. Best with lots of RAM.

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Copilot
tweaks.description: Turn off the Windows Copilot assistant by policy.

tweaks.name: Hide Copilot taskbar button
tweaks.description: Remove the Copilot icon from the taskbar.

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Recall
tweaks.description: Block Recall from taking AI snapshots of what you do.

tweaks.name: Disable Copilot in Edge
tweaks.description: Turn off the Copilot/Discover sidebar button in Microsoft Edge.

tweaks.name: Disable Bing & Copilot in search
tweaks.description: Keep Start search local and fast - no web/Bing/Copilot results.

tweaks.name: Remove Teams Chat icon
tweaks.description: Hide the consumer Teams 'Chat' button from the taskbar.

tweaks.name: Remove Xbox apps
tweaks.description: Uninstall the Xbox app bundle (keeps Game Bar services). Revert reinstalls them.

tweaks.name: Remove Widgets
tweaks.description: Remove the taskbar Widgets / Web Experience panel. Revert reinstalls it.

tweaks.name: Remove Bing News & Weather
tweaks.description: Uninstall the Bing News and Weather apps. Revert reinstalls them.

tweaks.name: Remove 3D Viewer & Paint 3D
tweaks.description: Uninstall the rarely-used 3D Viewer and Paint 3D apps. Revert reinstalls them.

tweaks.name: Remove Get Help & Tips
tweaks.description: Uninstall the Get Help and Tips apps. Revert reinstalls them.

tweaks.name: Remove Solitaire Collection
tweaks.description: Uninstall the Microsoft Solitaire Collection. Revert reinstalls it.

tweaks.name: Remove Maps
tweaks.description: Uninstall the Windows Maps app. Revert reinstalls it.

tweaks.name: Remove People app
tweaks.description: Uninstall the People app. Revert reinstalls it.

tweaks.name: Remove Phone Link
tweaks.description: Uninstall the Phone Link (Your Phone) app. Revert reinstalls it.

tweaks.name: Remove Clipchamp
tweaks.description: Uninstall the Clipchamp video editor. Revert reinstalls it.

tweaks.name: Remove Quick Assist
tweaks.description: Uninstall the Quick Assist remote-help app. Revert reinstalls it.

tweaks.name: Remove Microsoft To Do
tweaks.description: Uninstall the To Do app. Revert reinstalls it.

tweaks.name: Remove Feedback Hub
tweaks.description: Uninstall the Feedback Hub app. Revert reinstalls it.

tweaks.name: Remove Cortana app
tweaks.description: Uninstall the Cortana app package. Revert reinstalls it.

tweaks.name: Uninstall OneDrive
tweaks.description: Remove OneDrive entirely (runs its own uninstaller). Revert runs the installer to put it back.

tweaks.name: Restore the Windows 10 right-click menu
tweaks.description: Bring back the full classic context menu (no 'Show more options'). Restart Explorer or reboot after.

tweaks.name: Add 'End task' to taskbar menu
tweaks.description: Put an 'End task' option on the taskbar right-click menu to kill frozen apps fast.

tweaks.name: Add 'Copy to folder' to right-click
tweaks.description: Add a 'Copy to folder...' entry to the file right-click menu.

tweaks.name: Add 'Move to folder' to right-click
tweaks.description: Add a 'Move to folder...' entry to the file right-click menu.

tweaks.name: Open Explorer to This PC
tweaks.description: Open File Explorer to 'This PC' instead of Quick Access/Home.

tweaks.name: Show hidden files
tweaks.description: Show hidden files and folders in Explorer.

tweaks.name: Taskbar icons on the left
tweaks.description: Align the taskbar to the left (Windows 10 style). Revert centers it.

tweaks.name: Hide taskbar search box
tweaks.description: Remove the search box/button from the taskbar. Revert shows the icon.

tweaks.name: Hide Task View button
tweaks.description: Remove the Task View button from the taskbar.

tweaks.name: Hide Widgets button
tweaks.description: Remove the Widgets button from the taskbar.

tweaks.name: Show seconds in the clock
tweaks.description: Show seconds in the taskbar clock. Revert hides them.

tweaks.name: Disable Sticky Keys shortcut
tweaks.description: Stop the Sticky Keys prompt when you press Shift 5 times.

tweaks.name: Disable Xbox services
tweaks.description: Turn off the Xbox background services (Live, Game Save, networking). Revert sets them back to Manual.

tweaks.name: Disable Fax service
tweaks.description: Turn off the Fax service. Revert sets it back to Manual.

tweaks.name: Disable Remote Registry
tweaks.description: Keep the registry from being edited over the network (usually already off). Revert sets it to Manual.

tweaks.name: Disable Downloaded Maps Manager
tweaks.description: Turn off the offline-maps background service. Revert sets it back to Automatic.

tweaks.name: Disable Search indexing
tweaks.description: Stop Windows Search indexing - lighter on old/HDD PCs, but search gets slower. Revert turns it back on.

tweaks.name: Disable Print Spooler
tweaks.description: Turn off printing support - only if you don't use a printer. Revert turns it back on.

tweaks.name: Fix: remove Windows Update blocks
tweaks.description: The usual reason updates stop showing: clears policies that hide or pin Windows Update. One-time.
apply: Write-Output 'Windows Update policy blocks cleared (any already-absent ones were skipped).'

tweaks.name: Fix: restore Windows Update services
tweaks.description: Re-enable and start the services Windows Update needs if a debloat script disabled them. One-time.

tweaks.name: Fix: reset Windows Update (deep)
tweaks.description: Rebuild the update caches when updates are stuck or corrupted. Reboot after. One-time.

tweaks.name: Fix: repair system files (DISM + SFC)
tweaks.description: Repair a damaged Windows image and system files. Can take 15-30 min and needs internet. One-time.

tweaks.name: Fix: reset network stack
tweaks.description: Reset Winsock and TCP/IP and re-register DNS - fixes 'connected but nothing loads'. Reboot after. One-time.

tweaks.name: Fix: USB drive not detected
tweaks.description: USB stick or drive won't show up? Re-enables USB storage, clears write-protect and hide-drive policies, frees stuck drive letters, and rescans hardware. One-time.
apply: Get-Partition -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Type -notin 'Reserved','Recovery','System' -and -not $_.DriveLetter -and $_.Size -gt 0 } | ForEach-Object { try { $_ | Add-PartitionAccessPath -AssignDriveLetter -ErrorAction Stop; 'Assigned a drive letter to a volume that had none.' } catch {} }
Write-Output 'USB storage re-enabled and hardware rescanned. If the drive still does not appear, it is a cable/port/physical issue - try a rear USB port (directly on the PC) or another computer.'

tweaks.name: Pause updates (~35 days)
tweaks.description: Hold off all Windows updates for about 35 days. Revert resumes them.
apply: $k='HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\WindowsUpdate\UX\Settings'; if(-not (Test-Path $k)){ New-Item -Path $k -Force | Out-Null }; $now=(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ'); $end=(Get-Date).AddDays(35).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ'); Set-ItemProperty $k PauseUpdatesExpiryTime $end; Set-ItemProperty $k PauseFeatureUpdatesStartTime $now; Set-ItemProperty $k PauseFeatureUpdatesEndTime $end; Set-ItemProperty $k PauseQualityUpdatesStartTime $now; Set-ItemProperty $k PauseQualityUpdatesEndTime $end

tweaks.name: Stop forced update restarts
tweaks.description: Don't auto-restart to finish updates while you're signed in.

tweaks.name: Set wide active hours (6am-11pm)
tweaks.description: Keep updates from restarting during your day. Revert returns to automatic.

tweaks.name: Skip driver updates via Windows Update
tweaks.description: Stop Windows Update from replacing your drivers (install those yourself).

tweaks.name: Quick benchmark (safe, read-only)
tweaks.description: Measure CPU, RAM and disk speed right now - changes nothing. Run before and after a tweak to compare.

tweaks.name: Network test (ping + speed)
tweaks.description: Pings Cloudflare and Google for latency, then runs a quick download-speed test. Read-only - changes nothing.

tweaks.name: DNS benchmark (find fastest)
tweaks.description: Times how fast Cloudflare, Google, Quad9 and AdGuard resolve names, and names the fastest. Read-only.

tweaks.name: Free up RAM now
tweaks.description: Instantly trim app memory so cached pages leave RAM. Run it when things feel sluggish.

tweaks.name: Purge standby cache (free RAM)
tweaks.description: Clear cached 'standby' memory back to free RAM, like RAMMap. Great before a big game. One-time.

tweaks.name: Optimize / TRIM drives
tweaks.description: Run TRIM on your SSDs to keep them fast and healthy. One-time; safe to repeat.

tweaks.name: Empty Recycle Bin
tweaks.description: Permanently delete everything in the Recycle Bin. One-time.

tweaks.name: Reset Microsoft Store cache
tweaks.description: Clear the Store cache to fix download/install glitches (wsreset). One-time.

tweaks.name: Clear thumbnail cache
tweaks.description: Delete the thumbnail cache to fix broken or wrong image previews. One-time.

tweaks.name: Restart Explorer
tweaks.description: Restart the desktop/taskbar when it freezes or acts up. One-time.

tweaks.name: Clear temp files
tweaks.description: Delete your user TEMP folder contents (locked files are skipped). One-time.

tweaks.name: Clear Windows temp files
tweaks.description: Delete C:\Windows\Temp contents (locked files are skipped). One-time.

tweaks.name: Disable Core Isolation (Memory Integrity)
tweaks.description: Turns off VBS/Memory Integrity for a real FPS boost in games. Lowers security a bit — reboot needed.

tweaks.name: Disable CPU core parking
tweaks.description: Keeps all CPU cores awake for smoother frametimes instead of parking idle ones.

tweaks.name: Disable fullscreen optimizations
tweaks.description: Fewer stutters and faster alt-tab by turning off fullscreen optimizations globally.

tweaks.name: Disable background apps
tweaks.description: Stops Store apps running in the background to free CPU and RAM.

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Error Reporting
tweaks.description: Stops Windows sending crash/error reports to Microsoft.
apply: reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Error Reporting" /v Disabled /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
revert: reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Error Reporting" /v Disabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

tweaks.name: Disable Customer Experience program
tweaks.description: Turns off the Customer Experience Improvement Program (CEIP) telemetry.

tweaks.name: Disable lock screen ads & tips
tweaks.description: Stops Spotlight ads, 'fun facts' and tips on the lock screen.

tweaks.name: Disable File Explorer ads
tweaks.description: Removes the 'sync provider' ads/promos that show inside File Explorer.

tweaks.name: Disable 'finish setting up' nags
tweaks.description: Stops the 'Let's finish setting up your device' / 'Get more out of Windows' pop-ups.

tweaks.name: Dark mode for apps & system
tweaks.description: Switches Windows apps and system surfaces to dark mode.

tweaks.name: Compact view in Explorer
tweaks.description: Tighter row spacing in File Explorer so more fits on screen.

tweaks.name: Hide recent files in Quick Access
tweaks.description: Stops Explorer showing recently used files and frequent folders.

tweaks.name: Disable Snap Assist flyout
tweaks.description: Stops the pop-up suggesting other windows when you snap one.

tweaks.name: Disable Aero Shake
tweaks.description: Stops windows minimizing when you shake a title bar.

tweaks.name: Disable LLMNR
tweaks.description: Turns off Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution — small privacy and latency win.

tweaks.name: Disable NetBIOS over TCP/IP
tweaks.description: Disables legacy NetBIOS on all adapters — less chatter and attack surface.
apply: Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\NetBT\Parameters\Interfaces' | ForEach-Object { Set-ItemProperty -Path $_.PSPath -Name NetbiosOptions -Value 2 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; 'NetBIOS over TCP/IP disabled.'
revert: Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\NetBT\Parameters\Interfaces' | ForEach-Object { Set-ItemProperty -Path $_.PSPath -Name NetbiosOptions -Value 0 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; 'NetBIOS restored to default.'

tweaks.name: Fix: rebuild icon cache
tweaks.description: Fixes blank or broken icons by clearing the icon cache and restarting Explorer. One-time.
apply: Stop-Process -Name explorer -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item "$env:LocalAppData\IconCache.db" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item "$env:LocalAppData\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer\iconcache*" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Process explorer; 'Icon cache rebuilt - Explorer restarted.'

tweaks.name: Fix: reset Windows Firewall
tweaks.description: Restores Windows Firewall to default rules when something broke your connectivity. One-time.

tweaks.name: Re-register Microsoft Store
tweaks.description: Repairs a broken Microsoft Store by re-registering its app package. One-time.
apply: Get-AppxPackage Microsoft.WindowsStore | ForEach-Object { Add-AppxPackage -DisableDevelopmentMode -Register "$($_.InstallLocation)\AppXManifest.xml" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; 'Re-registered Microsoft Store.'
